name: dixiapp
description: Dixiapp: app interna de Grupo DMA La Bomba (caja, compras y bodega)

scripts.apk:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:marco: node scripts/modo-apk.js marco && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk:completo: node scripts/modo-apk.js completo && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease bundleRelease
